author.name: Linden Street Bakery
author.headline: Neighbourhood bakery · Sourdough, cakes and coffee since 1998

text: The shop front got a fresh coat of paint this week, and the new green door is finally in. We are open as usual: Monday to Saturday from 7 to 18, Sunday from 8 to 12. Come by for a coffee and tell us what you think of the new look. See you soon!

image.alt: The bakery shop front with a green and white striped awning, a window full of loaves and a green door
